topic: F2FS large-folio read support and lock tracing
status: unresolved necessity; candidate decisions remain provisional

status: runtime necessity unresolved; final conservative retention decision
evidence: SDK config enables USB_XHCI_PLATFORM and MFD_SYSCON. xhci-plat has native ACPI matches PNP0D10/PNP0D15; syscon is configured with OF. Port the generic hook call sites for vendor source/customization compatibility without adding any SoC controller. Native LTS control flow remains unless the trusted xHCI callback deliberately sets bypass. syscon config.name stays live through the callback using automatic cleanup. Exact SDK runtime consumers were not established and no hook execution test was performed.
